ConnectionStrings.//: SnapCRM's OWN database. Must be a DIFFERENT catalog than production.
ConnectionStrings.//readonly: READ-ONLY access to the production food DB (ideally a replica or a login with db_datareader ONLY). SnapCRM never writes here.

Crm.//killSwitch: Master off-switch. When true, NOTHING is sent (email/push/etc). Flip to false only after staging tests.
Crm.//semiAuto: Semi-auto agent. Routine pre-approved campaigns auto-run; everything new waits in the approval queue.

Brevo.//apiKey: Set via environment/secret, NOT in this file.

Hangfire.//: Uses the CrmDb connection; isolated from production.
